title: I directed AI coding agents to build a shooter on the real streets of my village in four days (UE5, Epic AI MegaJam)
author: IT8055

comments.author: IT8055
comments.body:
For the Epic AI MegaJam I wanted to see whether AI agents could turn the village I live in (Schwendi, Germany) into a playable map. It turned into a full game.

How it worked: I never wrote code or placed anything in the editor. I described what I wanted, looked at the results and sent things back when they were wrong. The agents (Claude Code) wrote about 45,000 lines of Unreal C++, Python tools that build the village from OpenStreetMap and state survey data, scripts that draw the paper soldiers, and a synthesiser that composes the music.

What went wrong along the way: the first packaged build would not start at all although every editor test passed; all the cars were imported inside out and nobody noticed for hours; the trailer took four cuts, and my own play footage beat bot footage every time.

Modes: co-op waves against paper soldiers, six versus modes for up to 8 fighters, 4-player split-screen, LAN, and a Director's Cut replay of every match.

Free for Windows: https://severecircle.itch.io/schwendi-wars
Happy to answer questions about the workflow.
